minutes.summary: The Public Access Cable Committee met by Zoom, re-elected its existing officers, and heard the manager's June report and year-end financials. The chair objected that the committee's capital request was left off the Town Meeting warrant, so there is no capital budget until November. The committee moved to authorize research into royalty-free music and agreed to keep meeting by Zoom through September.

what_happened.line: The committee re-elected its existing chair, vice chair and secretary by a 4-0 roll call; one member had not yet been sworn and did not vote.
The chair said the committee's capital request was left off the Town Meeting warrant, so there is no capital budget until a November request; no resolution followed.
A motion to authorize up to a set amount to research royalty-free music was put to a vote, but the minutes record the outcome as not audible.
The committee agreed to meet by Zoom in August and September, decide in September on meeting in person masked, and set the next meeting for August 3.
The year-end financial reports and the manager's June report were presented as information; the June expenses included the third-channel upgrade.

why_it_matters: Cable channel equipment and programming money comes from the committee's own budget, and without a capital warrant article, equipment needs must be met by line-item transfers until Town Meeting acts in November.
The music research could change what the channels pay for licensing, but the vote result was not audible, so the record does not confirm that it was approved.
watch_next: The next meeting on August 3, held by Zoom.
A November capital request, and a September decision on whether to resume in-person meetings with masks.
